Kerala Govt Cancels Scholarship Exam Amidst Allegations of Political Pressure

The Kerala Congress government has withdrawn its approval for the Balagokulam's Mayilpeeli Young Scholar Examination, a scholarship test for students in Classes 5 to 10. The exam offered scholarships worth Rs 1 lakh. Initial permission was granted, but later withdrawn following protests from Left organizations and alleged pressure from IUML and Jamaat-e-Islami. The BJP has alleged appeasement by the government.
